2. London PyTorch Meetup - a local community for PyTorch learners.
3. cr0hn on GitHub - another expert with PyTorch experience.

You can join the meetup or reach out to these experts with questions like "What are the best projects to practice PyTorch?" I can also provide draft messages to help you start the conversation. Would you like me to share those?
